Constraints.Constraint: Ceremony tier T1 (bounded test-evidence removal plus one orphaned test-hook deletion). Baseline commit cab71497765a3cff7171e746acf0decd90f2041b. Forced product write paths are src/grace-generate.test.ts, src/grace-cursor.test.ts, src/gates/core.test.ts, src/grace-cursor.ts, and derived test-metrics.json. The four test or derived paths have no module-ownable LINKS header; src/grace-cursor.ts declares LINKS: M-CURSOR. The owning modules M-CLI, M-CURSOR, M-GATES, and M-RELEASE-AUTOMATION are named here, in AffectedAreas, and in VerificationIntent. All other production source and files are untouched.

Deleting the src/grace-cursor.test.ts ordering case orphans its only caller. The src/grace-cursor.ts edit removes exactly that surface: the setCandidateLockCaptureOrderForTests export and its state, the three recording pushes inside observeCandidateLock, and the setter's module-map entry. observeCandidateLock keeps its open/fstat/read behavior and every other test hook is unchanged. This is a local test-hook cleanup, not a runtime lock redesign.

This phase overturns applied C-SUPERSEDE-MEMBERSHIP-4-20941257 AC-CLEANUP-BOUNDED row (b) and AC-REVIEW-VERDICT-THREE-PHASE case (c) only as current test obligations, and retires applied C-LINUX-VALIDATION-REPAIR-6-62765C22 AC-CLEANUP-PINNED-DISTINCT's distinct-inode cleanup probe and AC-PIN-SUCCESS-AND-REFUSAL's open-handle ordering evidence. Identity-only evidence is invalid for the agreed future serialization/content-pin boundary: an inode is an object-identity observation and a content hash is an integrity pin, never a lock, so neither proves mutual exclusion. The historical ext4 finding was real — path device/inode comparison let a same-path replacement impersonate the deleted object — and the runtime still pins the inode with an open handle; that guard is unchanged and the later coordinator/publication bundle owns the guarantee. The retained byte, token, foreign-entry, EEXIST/ENOTEMPTY, gate spec/ledger/location, and B/A/B controls prove their own behavior only; the AC-PIN-RELEASE-NO-LEAK and AC-PIN-ACQUISITION pin cases are later-phase targets, not replacement safety.

This overturns applied C-TEST-TIME-BUDGET-4-F173437E's no-test-deletion NonGoal (spec.xml:427-430) only for the four enumerated cases: that NonGoal kept useful coverage while removing duplicate suite passes, whereas these four assert an approach the agreed boundary rejects and their adjacent controls remain.

The committed test-metrics.json is stale in case identities and must be invalidated before measurement. scripts/test-metrics.ts:82-98 decides freshness from the file set and count sum only, so a same-file case deletion never refreshes case identities; the runner is not repaired here. The executor invalidates the artifact, runs bun run test:metrics as the single artifact writer, then confirms no provisional entry and no removed identity. The close bun run validate:ci is the second and last full-suite invocation; VerificationIntent states that cost.
